name: Sweet Hearts ~Sannin Ecchi~
source:
Main character brings has a girlfriend, but as of late she becomes friends with protagonist's co-worker waitress Haruka. One night they book a ryokan room for the three of them, get drunk and enjoy each other to the fullest.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角带来了一个女朋友，但最近她和主角的同事女服务员遥成为了朋友。一天晚上，他们三人订了一间旅馆房间，喝得酩酊大醉，尽情享受彼此。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
